adversarialIterations: Hardened permissions, redaction, provider-upload and release gates; removed unsupported tool claims.
Added strict nested validation, safe non-clobber exports and escaped sidecars.
Independent code review reproduced destructive input/output aliases; fixed and regression-tested before writes.
Aligned high-risk Python/Node validation cases with differential tests.
Pinned local GSAP, checked version/hash and retained non-MIT license notice.
Actual MP4 decoding exposed blank scene-boundary flashes missed by ordinary browser samples; removed full-scene fade, rerendered and reinspected exact boundaries.
Final independent review found SVG stroke-width attribute confusion; corrected exact attribute boundary and added passing differential regression. No new high-risk finding reported.
limits: Synthetic silent composition only: no real application capture, provider TTS, voice cloning or end-to-end narrated listening was performed.
Ten decoded frames are not exhaustive video review; automated motion assertions were disabled.
Node SVG preflight reads the opening-tag dimension header, not complete XML syntax; Python validation and browser/media review remain required.
The validators are not identical parsers: Python integer field typing is stricter than JavaScript JSON numeric representation. Use canonical integer version/canvas fields.
Trusted project and single writer required; concurrent malicious filesystem replacement and transactional bundle recovery are outside the guarantee.
An offline npm dependency build does not guarantee an offline renderer; cached CLI/browser/media prerequisites are separate.
Privacy and UI correctness cannot be established by manifest flags. Apply release gates to every actual delivery.
Embedded chapter navigation and literal subtitle entity display depend on the destination player.
